Commanded to build an ark, he and his house were saved through the flood.

The town of David where Jesus was born.
He baptized Jesus in the river Jordan and saw the Spirit descend like a dove.
Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding in this Galilean town — His first sign.
Though he swore he did not know the Lord, this disciple wept bitterly after the cock crew.

choices: What is the Mount of Olives?

This psalm opens, 'The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.' (Psalm 22 in the Septuagint numbering.)
Proverbs teaches that the fear of the LORD is the beginning of this.
A shepherd boy who slew Goliath, he became king and is remembered as the sweet psalmist of Israel.

choices: What is the Song of Solomon?
clues.clue: 'Vanity of vanities; all is vanity,' sighs the Preacher in this book.

The first martyr, he saw the Son of man standing at the right hand of God as the stones flew.

Paul's beloved companion, a physician who also wrote a Gospel and the Acts.

choices: What is the hand of God?

meta.note: Authored for private play. Scripture references use KJV numbering; Orthodox (Septuagint) psalm numbers are noted where they differ. Family Feud boards are our own house rankings, not a real survey.
meta.title: Mind Soul & Body — Game Show Question Bank
